definitions.explanation: Fighting or competition at very close range, where opponents are in direct physical proximity. Used in military, sports, and gaming contexts.

examples.japanese: {接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧な⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: In this game, I chose a character who is good at close-range combat.

examples.japanese: {接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In close-range fights, larger athletes have an advantage, but it can be compensated for with technique.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧ (approach, proximity) and ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (battle, fight).

Widely used in gaming contexts to describe melee combat as opposed to ranged combat. Also used figuratively in competitive contexts like elections or sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧ (to force into close combat)
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong at close range)
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to engage in close combat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}: close-quarters combat (general)
- {白兵戦|はくへいせん}: hand-to-hand combat (military, with weapons)
- {肉弾戦|にくだんせん}: hand-to-hand fight (emphasis on physical contact)
